title: Golden v1 run manifest
description: Run identity and the assertions declared BEFORE execution. Declaring assertions up front is what stops a run from choosing its own success criteria after seeing the evidence.

run_id.description: Unique per run. Evidence from one run must never be evaluated against another.

captured_at.description: When the EVIDENCE was collected. Never overwritten by a later evaluation.

evaluated_at.description: When the gates were re-derived offline. Distinct from captured_at: re-running an evaluator must not restate old evidence as freshly captured.

document_updated_at.description: When the prose was last edited. Distinct from both timestamps above.
